attributes.action: Request for Housing Associations to Be Accountable for Their Tenants’ Behaviour
attributes.additional_details:
Housing associations should have a duty to ensure that their properties are managed responsibly and that reports of antisocial behaviour, harassment, noise nuisance, or other disruptive conduct are taken seriously. Residents should be able to live in a safe and peaceful environment without ongoing disturbance or being expose to health hazards.

Greater accountability will help ensure that neighbourhoods remain safe, respectful, and enjoyable places to live.
attributes.background:
Request that housing associations take greater responsibility for addressing and managing the behaviour of their tenants when it negatively affects neighbours and the wider community.

Ask the housing associations be held accountable for responding promptly to complaints and investigating concerns

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. Housing associations are already required to meet regulatory standards which are set by the Regulator of Social Housing. You can find more information about this here: https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cdp-2024-0178/

You may wish to contact the Housing Ombudsman Service: https://www.housing-ombudsman.org.uk/

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
